scope: Functional diagnostic with this boot already having disabled Lockdep; no PM or validator reset

first_failure.log: aplay: main:850: audio open error: Operation not supported

interpretation: The failed request was refused at PCM OPEN with EOPNOTSUPP. The source also incorrectly reports an occupied playback direction as EOPNOTSUPP; AFE 0.1.29 corrects that to EBUSY. This is not proof of the origin of the earlier intermittent START EBUSY. Live contention and replacement tests must be qualified separately.
